# 作者解释: "Here the DP domain will not block, this is all_gather of all TPs

from typing import Optional, Dict
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

from vllm.config import VllmConfig
from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import FusedMoE

class DeepSeekV2MoE(nn.Module):
    """DeepSeek V2 MoE layer with shared expert DP optimization."""

    def __init__(self, config, vllm_config, ...):
        super().__init__()
        additional_config = vllm_config.additional_config
        # 修复 hardcode，从配置中读取并添加前置条件检查
        self.enable_shared_expert_dp = additional_config.get(
            "enable_shared_expert_dp", True
        ) and not self.torchair_graph_config.enabled \
          and vllm_config.parallel_config.enable_expert_parallel
        self.torchair_graph_config = vllm_config.torchair_graph_config

    def forward(self, hidden_states, ...):
        # DP 域内 all_gather 操作
        if self.enable_shared_expert_dp:
            hidden_states = dist.all_gather(hidden_states, group=dp_group)
        return self.experts(hidden_states)
